definitions.gloss: standing up, rising (from a seat); the command "Stand!"
definitions.explanation: Getting up from one's seat, especially all together at a signal; on its own it is the command used in Japanese classrooms and ceremonies.

examples.japanese: {起立|きりつ}、⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧、⟦{着席|ちゃくせき}→着席：18472_chakuseki⟧。
⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{起立|きりつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご{起立|きりつ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧、⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The chair said, "Those in favor, please rise."

notes:
Every Japanese schoolchild knows the start-of-class routine, called out by the class monitor: {起立|きりつ}, ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ, ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧, ⟦{着席|ちゃくせき}→着席：18472_chakuseki⟧ ("stand, attention, bow, sit"). Also used for voting by standing in parliaments and meetings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起立|きりつ}、⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧、⟦{着席|ちゃくせき}→着席：18472_chakuseki⟧: stand, bow, sit
- {起立|きりつ}⟦{採決|さいけつ}→採決：08395_saiketsu⟧: a vote by standing
- ご{起立|きりつ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please rise (polite)
- {起立性|きりつせい}⟦{低血圧|ていけつあつ}→低血圧：07103_teiketsuatsu⟧: orthostatic hypotension

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧: to stand up; the everyday verb
- ⟦{規律|きりつ}→規律：00236_kiritsu⟧: discipline, order (same reading)
